title: Malaysian Used-Car Listings — Daily Snapshots
subtitle: Daily append-only snapshots of a Malaysian used-car index
description:
Daily snapshots of a Malaysian used-car listing index, collected since 2026-07-19 and still running. Append-only: a price change is a new dated row, never an overwrite, so price cuts and delistings are directly measurable.

Two files. Read lotclock_daily_coverage.csv first: it says which days were actually walked properly, because a listing being absent means nothing on a day the crawl was capped or killed mid-run. lotclock_listings.csv has one row per listing in the full-census era, with duration and event columns ready for survival analysis.

Right-censoring is severe at the current window length (99.9%), so days-on-market is not estimable yet and any median of the observed exits is survivorship bias. The starter notebook shows this rather than hiding it. The sample is one dealer-heavy, premium- and Klang-Valley-skewed index, not the Malaysian market.

Collected honouring robots.txt and the published crawl-delay, no evasion, public index only, no personal data. Derived tables only, no raw HTML. Full method and caveats in DATA_CARD.md.
